editorial.description_en: A fern frond still uncurling: the first entry here green enough that nobody would call it a neutral.
editorial.description_ja: 開きかけの羊歯のような、明るい緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.800, C 0.052, h 138.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 若 (waka, young) + 羊歯 (shida, fern). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Young Fern" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 若羊歯. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ishi-midori at ΔE00 4.5, usu-shiba at ΔE00 6.7, hina-gusa at ΔE00 6.9. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
